approval.impact: Restart only the selected owned node (or reconcile without a restart). Restore its approved single replica; preserve identities and PVCs. Endorsement/enrollment may pause briefly.
approval.recovery: The immutable approval is reused after retry/restart. Committed configuration recovers forward. Verify every channel with NEW committed transactions; never delete a PVC to repair storage.

guidance: Workload readiness does not prove ledger consistency. Run an authorized transaction verification for fresh Fabric evidence.
